program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: residual calibration structure attribution
question: Inside the exact R30-excluded candidate set, do training-manifest jackknife instability or high prediction spread identify held-out calibration error after R32 ruled out magnitude conflict and magnitude extrapolation?
hypothesis: R32 found no useful magnitude-based residual discriminator: net historical magnitude-sign conflict was not enriched for error and prediction-magnitude extrapolation had zero coverage. The remaining error may come from unstable cross-manifest support in the unchanged R27 predictor. For each outer holdout, reproduce the exact R30-excluded candidate set and the unchanged full R27 fit. Before opening held-out outcomes, fit three jackknife submodels by omitting one of the three training manifests at a time, predict each held-out candidate with all three submodels, and freeze two diagnostics: JACKKNIFE_SIGN_INSTABILITY when submodel advantage signs are not unanimous, and HIGH_RELATIVE_JACKKNIFE_SPREAD when a candidate's submodel prediction range exceeds the within-holdout median range across the fixed non-equal candidates. Only after all diagnostics freeze may held-out outcomes be opened for sign-error and absolute-error attribution.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: training net-advantage magnitude conflict or prediction-magnitude extrapolation identifies residual calibration error inside the exact R30-excluded set
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: residual calibration failure may instead arise from instability of the learned predictor across training-manifest composition

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R32's magnitude-conflict subgroup was less error-prone than its control, and no candidate exceeded the training actual-advantage magnitude envelope.

diagnostic_definitions.JACKKNIFE_SIGN_INSTABILITY: the three leave-one-training-manifest submodels do not produce one unanimous non-zero sign for predicted held-out advantage
diagnostic_definitions.HIGH_RELATIVE_JACKKNIFE_SPREAD: max(submodel predicted advantages)-min(submodel predicted advantages) is greater than the median jackknife spread across the nine fixed non-equal candidates for the same holdout; the median is frozen before held-out outcomes open

cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: diagnostic accounting only; unchanged four manifests, R30 exclusion rule, R27 features/model family, candidate allocations, 1744 budget, capacity and held-out ordering
cause_effect_trace.qualification: same four sealed manifests, deterministic replay, all jackknife fits/diagnostics frozen before held-out outcomes, full Go regression, one-shot READY_RESEARCH
cause_effect_trace.held_out_result: compare flagged versus unflagged held-out predictor sign-error rate and mean absolute prediction error
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R33 cannot alter allocator behavior. Supported instability only authorizes a separately preregistered stability-aware correction.
cause_effect_trace.next_hypothesis: supported -> test only supported stability-aware correction; mixed/negative -> move to feature/representation calibration attribution without capacity growth

frozen_reuse.model: unchanged R27 ridge family and six features
frozen_reuse.full_fit: unchanged R27 fit on all three training manifests
frozen_reuse.jackknife_submodels: exactly three fits per holdout; each omits one training manifest and trains on the other two
frozen_reuse.spread_threshold: within-holdout median jackknife spread across all nine fixed non-equal candidates, computed before held-out outcomes

diagnostic_definitions.R30_EXCLUDED: training actual-advantage signs are not exactly one distinct non-zero sign
diagnostic_definitions.JACKKNIFE_SIGN_INSTABILITY: three jackknife predicted advantage signs are not one unanimous non-zero sign
diagnostic_definitions.HIGH_RELATIVE_JACKKNIFE_SPREAD: candidate jackknife spread exceeds the frozen within-holdout median spread

outcome_definition.sign_error: sign(full-fit predicted held-out advantage) != sign(held-out actual advantage)
outcome_definition.absolute_error: abs(full-fit predicted held-out advantage - held-out actual advantage)

classification_rules.supported: valid AND at least one preregistered instability diagnostic has coverage>=0.20, flagged sign-error rate >= unflagged+0.15, and flagged MAE >= unflagged*1.25
classification_rules.mixed: valid AND at least one instability diagnostic has both flagged sign-error rate > unflagged and flagged MAE > unflagged but none meets all supported thresholds
classification_rules.negative: valid AND neither instability diagnostic has both directional enrichments
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, candidate set, exact R30 exclusion reproduction, R27 model/features, jackknife composition, median-spread freezing, held-out ordering, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance or accounting requirement fails

thresholds.provenance: reuse R29 enrichment thresholds; jackknife spread threshold is training-only within-holdout median and is not selected from held-out outcomes

rsi_success_note: R33 is residual calibration attribution on already studied manifests and cannot establish allocator success.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, candidates, exact R30 exclusion rule, R27 model/features, jackknife composition, instability diagnostics, within-holdout median rule, enrichment thresholds, budgets/capacity, held-out ordering, classification, or authority after primary output.
